authorization_gate.note: Example consent references are synthetic test fixtures, not real consent grants.

runtime_capabilities_tested: shared SQLite coexistence with ADS-WORK-09 store
limitations: SHACL Turtle syntax parsed, but pySHACL runtime validation was not executed.
Database encryption, key management and owner authentication are not implemented.
No formal Consent / Policy Service is integrated; host must supply trusted active consent references.
Original binary source storage and physical deletion propagation are not implemented.
No live DingTalk, voice recorder, mail or calendar connector is configured.
Multi-device synchronization and production-grade tamper-evident audit are not implemented.
SPARQL runs on an in-memory graph loaded for one owner; this is not a production graph database.
